Stay on the ice

Cold arena.
Warm competition.

Hop onto your polar cub, steer across the frozen arena, and time your rams to send rival riders into the sea. As the ice cracks and breaks away, every round gets tighter.

The first version is designed for offline matches against three computer-controlled rivals, with no advertisements or in-app purchases.
